property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: At the beginning of your turn, you may heal a friendly character up to 5 clicks. If you do, at the end of the turn deal that character unavoidable damage equal to the number of clicks it healed.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: When a friendly character is attacked, you may choose that the attacker rolls an extra d6 in the attack roll. If you do, immediately before finalizing the attack roll remove a die with the highest result in that roll (Effects that reroll that attack will reroll all 3 d6s).

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: Friendly characters have "POWER: Deal 2 damage to an opposing character within 3 squares and 1 damage to each opposing character adjacent to them."

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: When a friendly character rolls a single d6, before finalizing the roll you may increase the result by +1.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: At the beginning of your turn, you may choose a friendly character. If you do, until your next turn lines of fire drawn to that character are blocked.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: At the beginning of your turn, you may place a friendly character in a square within 3 squares and line of fire of themselves.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: When an opposing character uses Energy Explosion, Poison, or Pulse Wave, you may choose a friendly character to have SAFEGUARD from that power this turn.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: When a friendly character would be KO'd, you may instead turn them to their last non-KO click and give them 2 action tokens. If you do, until the end of your next turn they can't heal.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: When an opposing character attacks, you may modify a friendly character's defense +2 until your next turn.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: When a friendly character makes a close attack and hits, after resolutions you may deal 1 penetrating damage to a hit character. If you do, until your next turn, friendly characters automatically break away from that hit character.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: Friendly characters have "POWER: Give an opposing character within 4 squares and line of fire an action token. Until your next turn, that character can't remove action tokens except by clearing."

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: At the end of your turn you may have a friendly character move up to 2 squares using [im:elevated,characters].

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: Friendly characters have "POWER: Deal 1 penetrating damage to up to 4 opposing characters within 4 squares."

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: At the end of your turn you may choose a friendly character that didn't attack this turn. If you do, remove an action token from it and heal 2 clicks.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: When you clear, you may heal each character that cleared action tokens this turn 2 clicks. If you do, those characters modify their defense +1 until your next turn.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: At the beginning of your turn, you may choose a character, equipment, or One-Shot of 5 points or less from outside the game. If it's a character or equipment, generate it adjacent to a friendly character. Otherwise, add it to your Sideline face-up. If you chose a game element, then after resolutions, remove Scroll of Wish from the game (it's scored immediately).

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: At the beginning of your turn you may generate up to 3 Web terrain markers within 4 squares of a friendly character. This game those markers have "Characters occupying this marker must break away to move and can't automatically succeed in their breakaway rolls. Remove this marker from the game if no character occupies it."

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: EFFECT: Powers: Energy Explosion Friendly characters can use Energy Explosion with a minimum range of 4. When they do, the damage dealt can't be reduced below 1.

Make a range attack targeting all opposing characters occupying squares along that line of fire, regardless of range or line of fire. Deal each hit character 2 penetrating damage instead of normal damage."
